name: GTA VI launch-day productivity audit
method_note: Every input is a dataset id from data/figures.csv. The only numbers written here are labeled conventions and the claim-reproduction check value.

claim_reproduction_tolerance_pct.label: assumption: rounding tolerance for the claim's approximate (~) inputs

claim_audit.attribution: Jose Garcia-Montalvo (Pompeu Fabra University), as cited in the claim's source rows

base.basis: matches the claim's own inputs, so the audit is apples-to-apples

sensitivity.basis: GDP per employed person per working day; sensitivity case only

low.basis: measured PTO-request increase above a normal Thursday (BambooHR platform), applied as a lift on the normal daily absence rate; the lift is never treated as an absence rate

high.basis: survey intent of full-time-employed gamers (GameSquare); overstates by nature

superbowl.sanity_cap: high-case absences must be below Super Bowl Monday absences

precedent_gtav_2013.wording: no dent was reported in contemporary coverage

context.survey_intent_note: survey-intent context only; never a model case
